Is “AI psychosis” real? Doctors checked the records of 215,712 mental health patients at one US hospital 🧠

Not medical advice. If you or someone close to you is struggling, talk to a doctor.

Source: Bergson, Vassall, Wright, McCoy, Schafer, Achee, Sheffield (Vanderbilt University Medical Center), “Characterizing Artificial Intelligence Psychosis in a Large Medical Setting”, JAMA Psychiatry, 2026.
